title: Fix Design App Coordinate System Mismatch
description: Fix the coordinate system mismatch between compose (Z-up) and Three.js (Y-up) in the Design app, using the same approach that was already applied in the Type editor.
summary:
Fixed coordinate system mismatch between compose (Z-up left-handed) and Three.js (Y-up) in the Design app, matching the approach used in the Type editor.

Root cause: ModelPiece group matrix was `toThreeRotation() * planeMatrix`, but `planeMatrix` operates in compose Z-up space while loaded mesh geometry (GLTF/FBX/OBJ) is in Three.js Y-up space. The mesh needs conversion to compose space before plane positioning.

Changes:
1. ModelPiece originalMatrix/diffedMatrix: Changed from `toThreeRotation() * planeMatrix` to `toThreeRotation() * planeMatrix * toComposeRotation()`. This converts mesh from Y-up to Z-up (toComposeRotation), positions via plane in compose space (planeMatrix), then converts to Y-up for rendering (toThreeRotation).
2. PlaneThree: Same matrix fix applied for plane axis visualization.
3. handleSceneDragEnd: Fixed drag-drop piece placement to properly convert Three.js ray intersection coordinates to compose coordinates (composeX=threeX, composeY=-threeZ, composeZ=0).

All 83 JS tests pass. Pre-existing TypeScript errors in @semio-tech/compose-js:build are unrelated.
